title: 3 Years of SPX Jade Lizard Data. The $30 Wide Put Spread Wins Every Time.
description:
Every combination of 7-day SPX jade lizard tested in this study came back with a positive average P&L. Win rates were spectacular across the board. But not all setups are equal, and the width of your put spread determines almost everything else about the trade.

The $30 wide put with a $10 wide call spread lets you go further out of the money while still collecting enough credit to cover the call spread width. The $20 wide forces you inside the expected move to collect enough. The $5 wide call spread lets you go furthest out of the money but collects the least. Three years of data across all six combinations, and the key takeaway is simpler than you think: once you pick your width, go as far out of the money as the credit will allow.

07:15 $30 by $10 Is the Recommended Setup for Mechanical Trading
08:45 $20 Wide Forces You Inside the Expected Move
09:30 Further Out Performs Better Once Width Is Set
10:15 Final Takeaway: Pick Width First, Then Maximize Distance
